prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Pleasanton California?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” personal injury lawyer—the right choice depends on your type of case, the lawyer’s experience with similar claims, and how you feel about their communication and fees.

A few options to compare based on the available listings:

- **Megan Burns, Mirador Law** — based in Pleasanton; listed for plaintiff-side personal injury and selected to Super Lawyers for 2018–2026. [Profile](https://profiles.superlawyers.com/california/pleasanton/lawyer/megan-burns/abcbe9c7-26e4-4553-8fa2-801df4647b34.html)
- **Paulo S. Kline Simon, Kline Simon Law Firm** — based in Pleasanton; listed for plaintiff-side personal injury. [Profile](https://profiles.superlawyers.com/california/pleasanton/lawyer/paulo-s-kline-simon/046aa9c8-a392-4a40-b1bd-471338f6948e.html)
- **Thomas E. Sokat** — serves East Bay personal injury clients from Pleasanton and Danville; listed practice areas include car, truck, motorcycle, construction, and wrongful-death cases. [Profile](https://lawyers.law.cornell.edu/lawyer/thomas-edward-sokat-143343)

These are starting points, not endorsements. When you speak with attorneys, ask who will handle your case, whether they’ve handled similar claims, how costs and contingency fees work, and what they see as the strengths and risks of your case. Check the attorney’s current license and disciplinary status with the [State Bar of California](https://www.calbar.ca.gov/).
